packageRules.description: Group every third-party npm dependency into a single non-major PR to minimize CI runs on this repo, excluding the vitest coverage-tooling family which is grouped and gated separately below.
Group major updates separately so a single breaking major cannot block routine patch/minor bumps.

vitest + @vitest/coverage-v8 move together and stay isolated from unrelated bumps: this repo enforces a 100% unit coverage CI gate, and a coverage-tooling break must never be masked by or block other dependency updates.

Major bumps of vitest/@vitest/coverage-v8 are the highest-risk change in this repo (can silently break the 100% coverage gate), so they are isolated into their own group and always require explicit Dependency Dashboard approval.
